text: I'd like you to make an explainer showing a seed sprouting, using simple animation. I've always found that little moment when a seed starts growing really satisfying, which is why I want to see it animated. It should be 8 seconds long and widescreen, in 16:9 format. For the voice-over, use these exact words: “A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.” Please don't include any on-screen text or music.
